key_insight: Random data splits reward recipe memorisation, while provenance-grouped evaluation reveals which models generalise to unseen perovskite solar-cell research.
engineering_relevance: Reliable device optimisation requires modelling fabrication methods and device architecture alongside absorber chemistry.
method: Map institutional provenance in the Perovskite Database.
Progressively separate duplicate devices, publications and institutions across evaluation splits.
Benchmark 13 models and analyse feature importance.
evidence_signal: Nearly two-thirds of curated devices share an exact recipe; tree ensembles lead on random splits, but composition-aware neural models excel on unseen institutions and future discoveries.
watch_item: Implementing provenance-grouped evaluation depends on accurate recipe matching and publication–institution metadata.
paper_title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
